name: Little Fox Coffee
description: Little Fox is a coffee cart in Riverton serving espresso drinks at Riverside Park and the Saturday farmers market.

pages.title: Little Fox Coffee | Coffee cart in Riverton
pages.text: Little Fox Coffee | Coffee cart in Riverton Little cart, big coffee. Little Fox is a coffee cart run by two friends. We pull espresso from a cart with a red awning. Where to find us Monday to Wednesday Riverside Park, north entrance, 7 to 11 am Saturday Riverton Farmers Market, 8 am to 1 pm We post changes and rain closures on Instagram: @littlefoxcoffee . Menu Drip coffee $3 Latte $4.50 Cold brew $4 Hot chocolate $3 Oat milk is the only milk alternative we carry, no extra charge. Say hi Email hey@littlefox.example.

pages.title: Book the cart | Little Fox Coffee
pages.text: Book the cart | Little Fox Coffee Book the cart We bring the cart to weddings, offices and school events, usually on Thursdays and Fridays. $300 covers up to 75 drinks and two hours. Each extra drink is $3. Email hey@littlefox.example with your date, place and number of guests.
